description_en: Queries the number of tables migrated in a Data Transmission Service (DTS) data migration or synchronization task
description_zh: 调用SummaryJobDetail接口统计DTS数据迁移或同步任务中迁移表的数量
kebab_example: aliyun dts summary-job-detail --dts-job-id l3m1213ye7l0000 --job-code 02 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SummaryJobDetail

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data migration or synchronization task
parameters.name: dts_job_id

parameters.help_en:
The migration phase. Valid values:
02: schema migration phase.
03: incremental data migration phase
parameters.help_zh:
迁移阶段，取值：
02：结构迁移阶段。
03：增量迁移阶段
parameters.name: job_code

parameters.help_en:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:
Forward: forward.
Reverse: reverse.

Default value: Forward.
You can set this parameter to Reverse to release the reverse synchronization link only when the topology of the data synchronization instance is two-way synchronization
parameters.help_zh:
同步链路方向，取值：
Forward：正向。
Reverse：反向。

默认取值为Forward。
当数据同步实例的拓扑为双向时，才可以传入Reverse以释放反向同步链路
parameters.name: synchronization_direction

parameters.help_en: The region in which the DTS instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: DTS实例所属的地域，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The migration or synchronization instance ID
parameters.name: dts_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of schema definition. Valid values:

before: schema migration or initial schema synchronization.
after: DDL operations during incremental data migration or synchronization
parameters.help_zh:
结构定义的类型，取值：

before：库表结构迁移或初始化。
after：增量数据迁移或同步的DDL操作
parameters.name: struct_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the node is a seamless integration (zero-ETL) node. Valid values:
true: The node is a seamless integration node.
false: The node is not a seamless integration node
parameters.help_zh:
是否无感集成（Zero-ETL）任务，取值：
true：是。
false：否
parameters.name: zero_etl_job

JobId.description_en: The ID of the data migration or synchronization task

ProgressSummaryDetails.description_en:
The array of migration object information.
The array is returned in the following format: [{"key":"Function","state":5,"totalCount":22},{"key":"Procedure","state":5,"totalCount":26},{"key":"Table","state":0,"totalCount":68},{"key":"View","state":5,"totalCount":100}]
ProgressSummaryDetails.description_zh:
迁移对象数组返回信息。
数组返回格式如下：[{"key":"Function","state":5,"totalCount":22},{"key":"Procedure","state":5,"totalCount":26},{"key":"Table","state":0,"totalCount":68},{"key":"View","state":5,"totalCount":100}]

Key.description_en: The object type of the migration object. Valid values: Table, Constraint, Index, View, Materialize View, Type (user-defined type), Synonym, Trigger, Function, Procedure (stored procedure), Package, Default, Rule, PlanGuide (execute plan), and Sequence
Key.description_zh: 迁移对象类型，返回值：Table（表）、Constraint（约束）、Index（索引）、View（视图）、Materialize View（物化视图）、Type（自定义类型）、Synonym（同义词）、Trigger（触发器）、Function（函数）、Procedure（存储过程）、Package（包）、Default（默认值）、Rule（规则）、PlanGuide（执行计划）、Sequence（序列）

State.description_en:
The migration status. Valid values:
0: finish (completed).
1: catched (waiting for synchronization).
2: init (initializing).
3: running (synchronizing).
4: warning (error).
5: failed (failed)
State.description_zh:
迁移状态，返回值：
0：finish（结束）。
1：catched（等待同步）。
2：init（初始化）。
3：running（同步中）。
4：warning（报错）。
5：failed（失败）

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of migration objects

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:
true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值：
true：请求成功。
false：请求失败
